tableDoc.borderedDescription: Markdown uses the same Table components with variant=bordered and size=sm. Table owns the frame, header background, cell typography and row separators; TableBody omits the last row separator. Static content rows can omit index.
tableDoc.loadingDescription: Keep the final headers and column structure mounted, then replace only the body while the data is loading.
tableDoc.tableVariant: plain keeps the default unframed presentation; bordered adds a rounded frame, horizontal scrolling, a raised header and stronger body text.
tableDoc.tableSize: sm uses compact label typography; md preserves standard body typography. Cell padding is shared.
tableDoc.tableContainer: External layout classes on the wrapper. className and native table attributes still apply to the table element.
tableDoc.rowIndex: Row index for proximity hover. Omit for header rows.
tableDoc.skeletonColumns: Number of placeholder cells rendered in every row.
tableDoc.skeletonRows: Number of placeholder rows rendered while loading.
tableDoc.skeletonCellClassName: Additional classes applied to every loading cell.
tableDoc.skeletonGetCellProps: Returns cell attributes for column sizing, sticky positioning, or other structural styles.
tableDoc.skeletonRenderCell: Replaces the default text-line Skeleton for cells with another final shape.
